issue_context.title: Unnecessary cost/complexity in ProcessManager.Win32.cs calling IsWow64Process
issue_context.body:
See https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/38908#discussion_r451250441

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/babe42689aa327a62f1cb536ee8a22cec253a790/src/libraries/System.Diagnostics.Process/src/System/Diagnostics/ProcessManager.Win32.cs#L100

"Opening a new process handle for the current process just to call IsWow64Process on it looks like an overkill. Calling `Interop.Kernel32.GetCurrentProcess()` should be enough - it is what we do in the other place where `IsWow64Process` is called."
